summary: Frontend-only test of re-enabling the dialler (reverse of SAFE-SOS-001), with MODE=live and PROFILE=closed_testing. Tested with Playwright on the web preview at 375x667, logged in as voicetest2026@example.com. window.open and window.alert were stubbed so taps could be recorded. Note: on web, tel: goes through window.location, so it cannot be captured; the checks were 'no Simulated alert' plus the status text. DIALLER: PASS on every requested screen. The call rows and buttons can be tapped again. None of them showed 'Not active' or 'Emergency calling is not active'. Taps did not show the 'Simulated — nothing sent' alert. /emergency and /women/nearest-help show 'Continue in your phone's dialler...' after a tap. Pro gating is still OFF: no pro-upgrade-card or paywall-upgrade-btn on Home or chat. Opening a screen never starts a call; code review found no openExternal('tel:') inside useEffect or a timer. Regression PASS: Home 'Heading out?' Start opens the /family-journey hub; the FJ sub-screens, Home card and Me row are all present; Trusted Circle and Guardian Journey screens render. SMS SAFETY: CRITICAL FAIL. In closed_testing with an empty EXPO_PUBLIC_SMS_TEST_CONTACTS, Silent alert shows the blocked notice and then still calls Linking.openURL('sms:<real contact>?body=...'). On a device this opens the SMS composer, pre-filled with the real trusted contact and the alert text. The status line then says 'Message prepared...'. Guardian Journey and alerts/[id] have the same problem: openExternal treats sms: as live in closed_testing and skips the test-contact allow-list. Visitor /visitor/intent: the 'Call 112 — Emergency' button sits below the fold (y about 808) on a screen with no ScrollView, so it cannot be reached at 375x667. This layout problem was already there before this batch. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av, expo-barcode-scanner or expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: The screen content is a plain View with flex:1 and no ScrollView (app/visitor/intent.tsx:93-136). The workflow cards push the 112 button to y about 808, and the page scrollHeight is 667. The button cannot be reached on a 375x667 phone. This was already the case before SAFE-SOS-001. It matters more now that the call button is meant to work again.

integration_issues.flow: SMS safety: Women's Shield Silent alert (closed_testing, empty SMS_TEST_CONTACTS)
integration_issues.issue: Tapping alert-contact-<id> calls composeSms, which shows 'Simulated — nothing sent ... Closed-testing SMS is limited to verified test contacts' and returns 'blocked'. composeAlert (src/women/helpActions.ts:30-37) then falls through because the result is not 'composer'. It calls openExternal('sms:<phone>?body=...'), and openExternal passes it to Linking.openURL because POLICY.closed_testing.sms === 'live' (src/outbound.ts:38, 107-113). Seen in the run: window.open('sms:+910000000001?body=I%20need%20help...') fired right after the blocked alert. The status then showed 'Message prepared. Review it and press Send...'. On a device this opens the real SMS composer pre-filled with the real contact.

From code review (not tapped, to avoid creating a backend journey record): app/women/guardian-share.tsx:148-150 calls openExternal(`sms:${phones}?body=...`) with the real trusted-circle phones. In closed_testing this goes straight to Linking.openURL. It never checks SMS_TEST_CONTACTS, so the real SMS composer opens for real contacts.
From code review: app/alerts/[id].tsx:71 calls openExternal(`sms:${owner_phone}`). This is live in closed_testing and bypasses the test-contact allow-list.
app/women/head-out.tsx:289-293 also calls openExternal('sms:...'). It is safe today only because EXPO_PUBLIC_ALERT_SIMULATION_MODE=true. If that flag is flipped, the same bypass happens.

issues: The helpline cards are 104x84 in a grid where only the left and right columns are used (112 left, 181 right, with an empty middle). The layout looks unbalanced. Cosmetic, and present before this batch.

action_items: CRITICAL: Make openExternal() apply the SMS rails to sms:/smsto:/mms: URLs in src/outbound.ts. Parse the recipients from the URL and block emergency numbers. In closed_testing, block any recipient not in SMS_TEST_CONTACTS, including a bare 'sms:&body=' with no recipient. Show the same blocked notice. This closes the hole for guardian-share.tsx:148-150, alerts/[id].tsx:71 and head-out.tsx:289-293 in one place.

CRITICAL: In src/women/helpActions.ts composeAlert, do NOT fall back to the sms: link when composeSms returns 'blocked' or 'simulated'. Only fall back for 'unavailable' or a thrown error. Also return a blocked or simulated status string, not 'Message prepared...'.

HIGH: In app/visitor/intent.tsx, wrap the content in a ScrollView, or pin the 'Call 112 — Emergency' button, so it can be reached on small screens. Add testIDs, e.g. visitor-intent-call-112, plus testIDs on the visitor/emergency and WorkflowScreen call buttons.
Optional: add a unit test asserting that in closed_testing with an empty SMS_TEST_CONTACTS, openExternal('sms:+91...') does not call Linking.openURL.
critical_code_review_comments: src/outbound.ts: POLICY.closed_testing.sms='live' combined with openExternal's channel-only check means the SMS_TEST_CONTACTS allow-list is only enforced inside composeSms. Any sms: URL sent through openExternal skips it.

src/outbound.ts: external_share is also 'live' in closed_testing (WhatsApp, mailto, share sheet). It is not SMS, but messages to real contacts can still leave the device that way, e.g. shareExternal in the trusted-circle and guardian flows. Confirm the owner intended this.
No automatic dialling found. Every openExternal('tel:') and openPhone() call is inside an onPress handler.
Known and out of scope: outboundGuard.test.mjs still fails on app/pay-upi.tsx:68 (Linking.openURL). Left unchanged as instructed.

The SOS sheet helpline list has no 1091 (it has 112, 100, 181, 1098, 15100, 108), and the Women's Shield grid has no hl-1091. Both match the content before SAFE-SOS, so the sos-dial-1091 / hl-1091 named in the review request do not exist. 1091 does appear on the chat SOS banner (sos-call-1091) and the action-plan safety gate.

rca_of_issue: SMS bypass. composeAlert calls composeSms, which correctly returns 'blocked' for a non-allow-listed contact in closed_testing. composeAlert then treats anything other than 'composer' as 'expo-sms unavailable' and falls back to openExternal('sms:...'). openExternal only checks channelDecision('sms'), which is 'live' for closed_testing, so it calls Linking.openURL. Reproduced: seed one trusted contact, open /women/silent-alert, tap 'Prepare SMS to ...'. The blocked alert appears, then window.open('sms:+910000000001?body=...') fires. Mitigation: enforce the recipient allow-list inside openExternal for SMS schemes, and stop the fallback when the result is 'blocked' or 'simulated'.
